interfaces: ai_lab.providers.invocation_record.build_invocation_record (assemble and validate a Slice A record)
ai_lab.providers.invocation_capture.capture_provider_invocation (capture on the admitted path, returns record and error)

limits: Capture is restricted to scripts/compare_providers.py. No other path emits records, and the validator rejects records claiming any other capture_path.

completeness_attestation is partial_declared_channels_only on this path: the manifest is not declared exhaustive for all effective-input channels, so no captured record qualifies as blind-witness evidence.
identity_verification_status is unresolved for every model executor; no resolution mechanism exists until Slice B.
governance_marker defaults to experimental and stays there until an admission consumer exists.

Relations are emitted with authoritative false and relation_source future_edge_seed; they are candidate-naming seeds, not authoritative graph edges. For a new-format artifact and a record carrying an output digest, the produced_by evaluator can establish the relation by recomputation; the seed's flag is never read and no seed is promoted.

Two governed readers of the records now exist: the ancestry evaluator (ContextManifest edge, PLAN-20260817-0001) and the produced_by evaluator (this amendment). C1 provenance_v1 activation, catalog resolution, roles and authorization, and lineage and admission remain unimplemented. No traversal composes the two edge classes, and no governed instance exists in which an artifact established as produced_by is also consumed through a ContextManifest edge.
Records are prospective only; invocations before this capability fall under the ABS-0004 Section 7 pre-provenance boundary.

Execution outcome is captured from 2026-08-10 forward, on the compare_providers path only, in an optional outcome block carrying stop_reason, stop_reason_field, input_tokens, output_tokens, content_block_types and text_chars (VERIFY-20260810-0001). The 182 records captured before that date carry no outcome block and their outcomes cannot be recovered. INVOCATION_STATUSES still admits only success and failure, so an invocation that returned without exception and produced nothing is still recorded status success; the outcome block is what distinguishes it. Admitting a third status value remains migration-required and is reserved to a separate decision under GAP-0006.

execution_profile records supplied rather than effective configuration. A parameter the provider defaulted, rather than one AI-Lab sent, is absent from the record even when it determines the outcome: reasoning_parameters is {} whenever no effort parameter is sent, which is accurate about the request and silent about the effort actually applied.

output_token_limit is recorded for the provider AI-Lab caps and is null for the provider it does not, with max_tokens_source provider_default_unset. No record captures the uncapped endpoint's effective limit, so a comparison round's records cannot establish that its two witnesses had comparable room to answer.

Pinned evidence for docs/self_model/PREDICATE_REGISTRY.md, tests/test_invocation_record.py does not match the current file contents. Those files were changed before 2026-08-10 by work that did not repin them, and VERIFY-20260810-0001 did not check them. The mismatch is recorded rather than repaired: repinning would assert a verification that has not happened.

Output digests exist only for captures at or after 92c9468: 182 historical records carry no outcome block and 30 carry one without a digest, and all remain unresolved by their distinct enumerated reasons. Seed lines written before the JSON rendering fix are Python reprs and evaluate unresolved with reason ambiguous_attribution.
name: Invocation provenance capture (ABS-0004 Slice A)
recommended_next_actions: Propose Slice B (catalog identity resolution) against GAP-0005, incorporating the COMP-0035 finding that naming a provider self-report CatalogVerification is circular self-attestation.
Decide whether ABS-0004 requires a v5 amendment renaming CatalogVerification or scoping the term to what endpoint authentication actually proves.
Consider a check that execution-profile fidelity has not silently degraded after provider refactors.

Address GAP-0006 by additive outcome capture on the compare_providers path: an outcome object carrying stop_reason, output_tokens and returned content block types. Do not redefine INVOCATION_STATUSES in the same change; admitting a third status value is migration-required, since previously persisted records asserting success would need re-adjudication and no schema-versioning policy exists for self-model records.
risks: Schema v1 field choices are load-bearing for Slices B to D; a field misdesign propagates, mitigated by copying ABS-0004 v4 names verbatim and by the enumerated identity subset that isolates later additions.
Capture depends on reading private provider attributes for execution configuration; a provider refactor could silently reduce profile fidelity, which no current check would catch.
The governed rider raised the Claude output-token default to 16000, increasing the cost ceiling per call.
summary: Provider calls on the scripts/compare_providers.py path emit atomic InvocationRecords in schema v1: executor reference with identity verification status, requested API model name, service endpoint, session identity, occurred_at, status, governance marker, spawned edges, a minimal EffectiveInputManifest (rendered prompt digest, instruction and tool-schema digests, ContextManifest reference, prior tool-result references, session-state mode, completeness attestation), and an ExecutionProfile (endpoint, requested model name, output-token limit and its source, sampling and reasoning parameters, request flags, SDK runtime version). Records are validated by validate_invocation_record, serialized as byte-stable canonical JSON at deterministic paths under docs/invocations/, and identified by a digest over the enumerated version-scoped subset IDENTITY_FIELDS_V1 so that later slices cannot alter existing identities. Relations are emitted only in GraphRelation shape and only for the seven ABS-0004 Section 5 Slice A predicates. Capture is additive: failures are reported and never abort a provider call, and no consumer reads the records.
